label: Slack notifications and reviewed ChatOps
summary: Prepare scoped Slack delivery of redacted events and separately reviewed interactive operation requests.
core_boundary: Chat membership or a signed message never replaces Core identity, current permission checks, reauthentication or approval. This is a design-only connector proposal. Essential hosting, current actor and tenant authorization, native service drivers and recovery remain in the free Core. No production interface, publisher trust, installation or effectful capability is established by this metadata.
acceptance: Bind each workspace and channel to an admitted notification policy with explicit data redaction and tenant routing.
Qualify signed request freshness, replay protection, actor linking and current Core authorization before any proposed ChatOps action.
Bound queues, retries and message size; notification failure must not block host operations or lose the local audit record.

Before implementation, qualify an explicitly selected provider/interface revision, supported compatibility matrix, immutable package provenance, dependency inventory and licensing model; no release is admitted by this proposal.

Enforce current Core actor, tenant and capability checks at each admitted request; keep credentials in scoped secret references, redact diagnostics and reject arbitrary destinations, shell commands or host/container sockets.

Demonstrate that disablement, removal, provider outage and commercial entitlement loss preserve essential Core access, hosted workloads, local audit and recovery; retain owned data unless a separately authorized purge is requested.
